name: voxtral-tts
description: Mistral Voxtral TTS — convert text to speech using Mistral's Voxtral model ($0.016/1,000 chars). Use when asked to speak a response aloud, send a voice note to Discord or Telegram, or when the --voice flag is set on any coding agent response. Also use when Keith says "read that to me", "voice note", or "send as audio".
